caveats: SYNTHETIC DATA: every price, action and macro observation in this dataset was generated from a seeded model. Results describe the generator, not any market.
Fills at the next session open of each market; participation cap 0.1; partial fills allowed; day orders expire unfilled.

Costs: commission_per_share=0.0, commission_per_order=0.0, commission_bps=0.0, half_spread_bps=2.0, slippage_bps=2.0, impact_coeff=0.0, fx_cost_bps=2.0, borrow_bps_annual=50.0, apply_transaction_taxes=True
Dividends are credited on the ex-date (pay-date lag ignored); splits scale quantity only for RAW-priced series.
Markets closed on a union-calendar session are marked at their last available close.
Vendor adjustment state(s): ['raw']; signals use as-of adjusted prices, fills use stored prices.
Fee-schedule rules not yet verified against primary sources: ['uk.ptm_levy@2023-04-10', 'us.sec_section31@2024-05-22', 'us.finra_taf@2024-01-01'].
FX rates are vendor daily closes (~17:00 New York); equity closes earlier in the day are converted at that fix. Missing FX dates are forward-filled, never back-filled.
Universe/survivorship quality was not supplied to this run; treat results as an upper bound.
Universe 'demo_all' quality: current_only; coverage of historical members with price data: 100%. Results are an upper bound when coverage < 100% or quality is not pit_complete.
1 variant(s) of 'xs_momentum' were run in this process; the deflated Sharpe ratio (stage S5) accounts for this.
